subject: math

objective.text: Create and solve multi-step word problems from tape diagrams and equations.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective

explanations.title: Story from a tape diagram
explanations.text: Pick a context that fits the diagram. Write a statement about the total. Ask a question about the unknown. Tell the other information.

source_ref.section: Concept Development

explanations.title: Tape diagram from an equation
explanations.text: Each number in the equation is a part or the total. Draw tapes for the parts. Add a bracket for the total and a letter for the unknown.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 4

explanations.title: Solve for the variable
explanations.text: The variable is the unknown number. Subtract the known parts from the total to find it.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Problem 4

explanations.title: Check the answer
explanations.text: Round the numbers to estimate. The exact answer should be close to the estimate.

source_ref.section: Concept Development

examples.title: 5,233 plus 3,094 plus k equals 12,946
examples.text: The total is 12,946. Two parts are 5,233 and 3,094. The unknown part k is 12,946 minus 5,233 minus 3,094, which is 4,619.

assets_required.why_this_method: The lesson uses tape diagrams the child draws and the source diagrams are pictures. The child cannot draw here.
assets_required.description: A tape diagram builder. The child types an equation with a variable and sees a tape diagram with the parts, the total bracket and the unknown. The child can then solve for the variable.
must_show_exactly: A text box for an equation with a variable
A tape diagram with one segment for each part
A highlighted segment for the unknown
A box to type the value of the variable
An estimate check next to the exact answer
states_or_frames: Tape diagram drawn from the equation
assets_required.interaction: Child types an equation. The widget draws the tape. The child solves for the variable and checks it with an estimate.
assets_required.alt_text: A tape diagram drawn from an equation with the unknown highlighted.
assets_required.generation_caption: A clean tape diagram with three labeled segments, a bracket for the total and one highlighted unknown with a variable. [Build by code]
assets_required.review_notes: Source tape diagrams are pictures with no numbers in the .md. Build from typed equations.

visual_generation_rules: Diffusion cannot count reliably. Any picture where an exact number of objects matters must be built by code (SVG or widget) or drawn by an artist.

Every visual must be checked by a person: the count shown must equal the stimulus in the question and the rubric answer key.
Animations are described as frames with exact counts per frame, so they can be built or generated and then checked frame by frame.
